title: Mycelial Self Awareness
definition: The concept that the CADMIES mycelium is aware of its own structure and content, including concepts about itself.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a library that not only stores books but also has a section about its own collection. That's mycelial self-awareness.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Mycelial self-awareness is the ability of the CADMIES mycelium to contain and reason about concepts that describe its own structure and content. This creates a meta-layer of knowledge within the system.
difficulty_levels.expert: Mycelial self-awareness is a philosophical concept that explores the implications of a system being aware of its own content. It raises questions about the nature of self-reference and self-description, and its connections to other fields like metaphysics and the theory of language. It also highlights the challenges of building systems that can accurately and consistently reason about themselves.

extra_fields.insight: The mycelium now contains its own origin story, demonstrating its ability to reason about and describe its own content.
